list_datasets: list all available dataset names registered in the detectron dataset catalog
check_dataset_exists: check if a named dataset like coco_2014_train exists in the catalog
get_image_directory: get the image directory path for a dataset such as coco_2014_train
get_annotation_file: get the annotation file path for a dataset like voc_2012_train
get_image_prefix: get the optional image prefix for a dataset or return an empty string
